folderShelf.foldersFile.description: Absolute path of the JSON file that stores the folder list (e.g. `/Users/me/sync/folders.json`). `~` expands to the home directory. Leave empty to use `~/.folder-shelf/folders.json` (default), falling back to the extension's global storage if unavailable.
